# 2 Baruch Chapter 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** In the twenty-fifth year of King Jeconiah of Judah, the Lord spoke to Baruch, Neriah's son:

**2** "Do you see what this people has done against me? The two tribes who stayed behind are worse than the ten tribes who were taken captive.

**3** At least those earlier tribes were driven out by their kings. These two brought their captivity on themselves — they pressured their own king into sin.

**4** So I am bringing disaster on this city and its people. For a time it will be hidden from my sight.

**5** I will scatter this people among the nations. Through that scattering they will benefit those nations, and my own people will be disciplined by it. When they are tested they will cry out."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering for modern readability. "Hidden from my sight" conveys the idiom of divine absence. The scattering as both punishment and blessing-to-nations reflects the Abrahamic motif.*
